label: Unbroken take
description: Continuous camera geography with no hidden cuts or state resets.
principles: Treat the sequence as one uninterrupted take. Do not insert cuts, transitions or speed ramps unless explicitly authored.
Keep camera inertia, subject trajectories, parallax and occlusion physically coherent.
Carry wardrobe, lighting, environment and object positions continuously through time.
Reach the specified ending through visible action rather than teleportation or an unrelated composition.
evidence_status: Original direction heuristics; visual effectiveness requires provider renders and human evaluation, not guaranteed by unit tests.
priority: approved shot timing and reference roles
